item: The All keywords zip, the keyword digest and the JSON stream hold a batch in memory, never the corpus (the crash on 6-8 GB machines)
status: SHIPPED (draft PR; synthetic-corpus measurements, the operator's own FULL bundle still owed)
summary: One ordered mention scan into per-language bounded heaps that spill to SQLite under a budget from the memory available; flat article arrays; streaming stop-word, ring and suspect digests that reproduce the old order; the zip streamed to a scratch file a batch at a time; build_families through a token index so the summary groups the whole window (limit: a tenth of free memory); the R27 gate for the digest sized from the instance's counts; a disk preflight; a trim loop that converges and no longer claims a guaranteed cap. Peak RSS old then new on synthetic field-shaped databases: digest 776 MB to 267 MB (2 M keywords) and 2.2 GB to 273 MB (6 M); capped all-keywords zip 4.4 GB to 1.8 GB and 10.6 GB to 2.2 GB; byte-identical output on 14 random databases.
